from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class DocumentCase(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information for a single judgment document to support legal classification."""
    document_title: str = Field(description="The title of the judgment document (e.g. '《判决文书1》')")
    legal_domain: str = Field(description="The broad legal domain (e.g., 'Administrative', 'Criminal', 'Civil')")
    case_sub_type: str = Field(description="The specific type of case or administrative action (e.g., 'Compensation', 'Coercion', 'Execution', 'Maritime Dispute', 'Criminal Charge')")
    procedural_status: str = Field(description="The procedural stage of the case (e.g., 'Retrial', 'Execution', 'First Instance', 'Appeal')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    documents: list[DocumentCase]
